tabkeeper.enabled.title: Enable Tabkeeper
tabkeeper.enabled.description: Turn automatic branch-to-tab synchronization on or off.

tabkeeper.preserveActiveDocument.title: Preserve active document
tabkeeper.preserveActiveDocument.description: After restoring pins, return focus to the document that was active before the branch switch.

tabkeeper.scope.title: Managed scope
tabkeeper.scope.description: Whether pinned tabs are managed anywhere in the repository or only below the solution folder.

tabkeeper.maximumRestoredTabs.title: Maximum restored tabs
tabkeeper.maximumRestoredTabs.description: Upper limit on how many saved documents are opened and pinned for one branch switch.

tabkeeper.restoreDelayMilliseconds.title: Restore delay (ms)
tabkeeper.restoreDelayMilliseconds.description: Wait after a detected checkout before restoring pins, so a slow checkout can finish writing files.

tabkeeper.missingFileBehavior.title: Missing file behavior
tabkeeper.missingFileBehavior.description: What to do when a saved pinned file does not exist on the destination branch. Missing files are always logged.

tabkeeper.detachedHeadBehavior.title: Detached HEAD behavior
tabkeeper.detachedHeadBehavior.description: Keep a per-commit pin set while HEAD is detached, or always unpin instead.

tabkeeper.pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Fallback polling interval (seconds)
tabkeeper.pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often Git HEAD is re-checked when the filesystem watcher misses a change.

tabkeeper.rules.title: Branch rules (JSON)
tabkeeper.rules.description: A JSON array of { "pattern", "pinSetName", "enabled" } objects. The most specific matching pattern wins; a disabled rule excludes matching branches from synchronization.
